Hi @eng-32! Regarding the design review for `parse_range`: it was agreed that if the end time is earlier than the start time, it's a night shift. In that case, the end time belongs to the next day, and 1440 minutes should be added to it (e.g., "22:00-06:00" becomes (1320, 1800)). As for `parse_hhmm`, I'm not sure about its status, maybe check with @eng-87.

Hi! On SLOTPLAN-105 the acceptance test expects intervals_overlap((600,600),(540,660)) to be False. I.e. a zero-length (empty) interval never overlaps, even when it sits inside another interval. Can you confirm that's the agreed decision? Also any other edge cases (e.g. both empty, touching)? Thanks!
